prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Master Desktop Companion Controls", "Press Alt+P to summon or hide your pet anytime. Double click to interact or open pet chat.", "Shortcut Guide", "Complete Onboarding"]
1: ["Upload High Quality Pet Photo", "For best generation results, use clear lighting with your pet centered in the frame.", "Ensure face is fully visible without strong shadows.", "Select Clear Photo", "Clear front lighting works best"]
2: ["Secure Account Sign-In", "Sign in to keep your pet and preferences synced across all your devices permanently.", "Your pet state is linked securely to your authenticated account session.", "Session Auto-Sync Active"]
3: []
4: ["Signing in anchors your companion identity safely to your account profile."]
5: ["Bringing Your Companion To Life", "Your pet is being crafted. Desktop placement will trigger automatically when ready."]
6: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Confirm your companion's name to finalize adoption and bring them to your desktop immediately.", "Adopt & Launch to Desktop"]
7: ["Choose Your Companion", "Select the pet personality and style that fits your desktop setup."]
8: ["Welcome Your Desktop Companion!", "Your companion is now active on your desktop screen. Click below to try your first interaction.", "Companion Active", "Try First Interaction"]
9: ["You will receive a notification when your desktop pet is ready to interact."]
